Text: Java has {{c1::javac}} to compile source code to {{c2::bytecode}}.
Extra: The output bytecode resides in `.class` files.

Text: If a class `MyClass` is public, it must be declared in a file named {{c1::MyClass.java}}.
Extra: The filename is case-sensitive and must match the class name exactly.

Text: The JRE includes the {{c1::JVM}} and the {{c2::runtime/core libraries}}, but lacks development tools like `javac`.
Extra: To compile Java source code, a JDK is required.
